summary: Added cost-weighted view to scripts/bench-report.js. Constants INPUT_W=1.0/OUTPUT_W=5.0/CACHE_READ_W=0.1/CACHE_CREATION_W=1.25 (documented as approximate). costTokEq() weights each usage bucket; rows now carry costGross/costNet stats and ratios carry costGrossOnOverOff/costNetOnOverOff. readSplit already returned per-component sums, so no accounting change needed. report.md now has separate "Raw tokens" and "Cost-weighted (tok-equivalents)" per-arm sections plus raw+cost ON/OFF ratio columns, with approximate-weight notes. Test extended with cost math incl. a cache_read-heavy line (raw 10020 vs cost 1060); 42/42 pass. Not committed; restored repo's bench/report.* sample artifacts.
